California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.
descriptions.job-19fpnfn:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

What you’ll do

As part of our growing, global Product Support team, you will be a critical driver in delivering exceptional user experiences. This role goes beyond basic troubleshooting—it's about using your technical expertise, analytical mindset, and project management skills to strategically improve our support systems, processes, and product quality.

You will take ownership of complex, technical user issues and work across teams, including Engineering and Product, to resolve them. A deep understanding of SQL and APIs will allow you to engage with these teams effectively, analyze data to inform decisions, and propose solutions that drive operational efficiency. Your work will focus on scaling support operations, creating better user experiences, and pushing forward continuous improvements that align with Stripe's key metrics, such as Consumer Satisfaction (CSAT), Contact Rate, and Service Level Agreements (SLA).

Responsibilities

  • Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues through direct user interaction (email, phone), utilizing SQL to extract and interpret data, and leveraging your knowledge of API documentation.
  • Develop product and platform expertise, working closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to diagnose and resolve user issues.
  • Strategically optimize and scale support processes to enhance efficiency and improve the overall user experience, incorporating data-driven insights and metrics.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives aimed at hitting key performance metrics (SOKRs) such as Consumer Satisfaction (CSAT), Contact Rate, and SLA compliance.
  • Create and refine documentation to empower users to resolve issues via self-service, reducing dependency on support teams.
  • Collaborate and advocate with Product and Engineering to proactively improve the platform based on user feedback, ensuring long-term product reliability.
  • Lead cross-functional projects aimed at identifying inefficiencies in current processes and driving the implementation of long-term solutions.
  • Constantly challenge the status quo and push for innovation in user support strategies and operational processes.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the following requirements to succeed in this role:

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing product support role, with a focus on troubleshooting technical issues.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and querying, with the ability to interpret datasets.
  • Experience working with APIs 
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, capable of diagnosing complex issues and driving them to resolution.
  • Proven experience in stakeholder management, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive progress.
  • Experience in project management, particularly in optimizing processes, workflows, or support operations.
  • Willingness to work occasional weekends and holidays (with compensatory time off).

Preferred qualifications

  • Strong analytical skills with a passion for interpreting data to improve decision-making and outcomes.
  • Comfort explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in technical environments and the ability to diagnose and resolve highly technical user issues.
descriptions.job-0m10c4j:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. Our products and services, including Square, Cash App, Afterpay, TIDAL, Bitkey, and Proto, help millions of people around the world access, manage, and move money with more flexibility and control. We believe everyone should be able to participate and thrive in the economy, and we build tools that make commerce and financial services more accessible.

Block’s Financial Operations team is responsible for the movement of money through our bank partners, card networks, payment partners, and internal platforms. The team’s mission is to ensure our customers’ experience taking payments, completing sales, settling funds, and getting paid is reliable, efficient, compliant, and cost effective. To deliver on that mission, Block operates within a complex and highly regulated ecosystem of financial institutions, payment networks, industry partners, regulatory requirements, and internal systems. Financial Operations plays an integral role in shaping the infrastructure, controls, partner relationships, and operational capabilities required to support Square’s long term growth in Japan.

As Head of Financial Operations, Japan, you will lead Square’s financial operations strategy in the market. You will own critical payment and banking partner relationships, strengthen operational resilience and controls, and ensure Square can scale reliably in Japan. This Tokyo based hybrid role requires deep payments expertise, strong commercial judgment, and the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.

The Role

In this role, you will translate Square Japan’s Financial Operations strategy into measurable outcomes. You will work across payments, product, operations, partnerships, and regulatory engagement to improve performance, support new capabilities, and help Square grow in a complex and highly regulated market.

You Will

  • Lead the execution of Square Japan’s Financial Operations priorities, turning regional and global strategy into clear market plans and outcomes.
  • Own operational performance for incoming and outgoing payments, including reliability, settlement, incident management, controls, cost efficiency, and seller experience.
  • Build and manage senior relationships with banks, acquirers, card networks, payment providers, industry bodies, regulators, and other strategic partners.
  • Lead commercial and operational negotiations with payment and banking partners to support Square’s growth, product roadmap, risk requirements, and cost objectives.
  • Represent Square Japan in partner, industry, regulatory, and public forums where Financial Operations expertise is required.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Policy, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to launch new capabilities and resolve market specific challenges.
  • Identify opportunities to improve authorization performance, settlement reliability, reconciliation, payment costs, dispute outcomes, vendor performance, and operational controls.
  • Monitor regulatory, network, partner, and industry changes in Japan and lead coordinated responses across internal teams.
  • Establish governance, reporting, operating rhythms, and escalation paths that improve decision making, transparency, and accountability.

You Have

  • 15+ years of experience in fintech, payments, banking, card networks, acquiring, issuing, payment operations, or related financial services roles.
  • Deep expertise in Japan’s payments ecosystem, including card networks, acquirers, issuers, processors, banks, regulators, government bodies, and industry associations.
  • A strong track record building and influencing senior relationships with partners, financial institutions, regulators, industry bodies, and market stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial judgment, including experience negotiating complex agreements and balancing cost, risk, compliance, customer experience, product outcomes, and growth.
  • Experience representing a company externally with senior partners, regulators, government stakeholders, industry bodies, or public facing audiences.
  • Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, translate complexity into clear plans, and deliver measurable outcomes across business, product, operational, regulatory, and technical challenges.
  • Experience leading complex cross functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Policy, Marketing, and Operations teams.
  •  Executive level communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to make clear and persuasive recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Native or business level Japanese proficiency, including the ability to negotiate, influence, and build trust with Japan based partners and regulators.

Even Better

  • Experience working directly with key regulators or government bodies in Japan, including METI, JFSA, or relevant payments and financial services authorities.
  • Understanding of Payment Facilitator, acquiring, issuing, settlement, clearing, reconciliation, and card network operating models.
  • Experience working in a US headquartered fintech, technology, payments, or financial services company.
  • Media training or experience serving as an external spokesperson, industry representative, or senior market leader.

財務オペレーション責任者（日本）

会社概要

Blockは、経済的な可能性を広げるという共通の目的のもと、多くの「ブロック」が団結した企業です。Square、Cash App、Afterpay、TIDAL、Bitkey、Protoなど、弊社の製品やサービスは、世界中の何百万人もの人々が、お金へのアクセスや管理、移動をより柔軟にコントロールできるようサポートしています。弊社は、誰もが経済活動に参加し、成功を収める機会を得られるべきだという信念のもと、商取引や金融サービスをより身近なものにするツールを構築しています。

Blockの財務オペレーションチームは、取引先銀行、カードネットワーク、決済パートナー、社内プラットフォームを通じた資金移動に関する業務を担っています。チームの使命は、顧客である加盟店さまが、決済受付、販売の完了、資金の精算、売上金の受け取りを確実かつ効率的に、規制に準拠した費用対効果の高い方法で行えるようにすることです。この使命を果たすため、Blockは、金融機関、決済ネットワーク、業界パートナー、規制要件、社内システムで構成される、厳格に規制された複雑なエコシステムの中で事業を運営しています。財務オペレーションチームは、日本におけるSquareの長期的な成長を支えるために必要なインフラストラクチャ、管理体制、パートナー社との関係、運用能力を構築する上で不可欠な役割を果たします。

日本の財務オペレーション責任者の役割は、市場におけるSquareの財務オペレーション戦略を主導することです。重要な決済パートナー社や取引先銀行との関係を統括し、業務のレジリエンスと統制を強化するほか、日本でSquareが安定して事業を拡大できるようにしていただきます。東京を拠点とするこのハイブリッドな役割には、決済に関する深い専門知識、優れた判断力、社内外の上層部のステークホルダーに働きかける能力が求められます。

職務内容

この役割では、Square株式会社の財務オペレーション戦略を測定可能な成果として具体化することが求められます。決済、製品、業務、パートナーシップ、規制当局との連携などの分野にわたって、パフォーマンスの向上、新たな機能の導入、厳格に規制された複雑な市場におけるSquareの成長をサポートしていただきます。

主な業務

  • Square株式会社の財務オペレーションにおける優先事項の実行を主導し、地域およびグローバル戦略を明確な市場計画や成果として具体化する。
  • 信頼性、決済、インシデント管理、管理体制、コスト効率、加盟店さまの体験など、入出金に関する運用パフォーマンスにおいて責任を持つ。
  • 銀行、加盟店管理会社、カードネットワーク、決済プロバイダー、業界団体、規制当局、その他の戦略的パートナー社の上層部との関係を構築・管理する。
  • Squareの成長、製品ロードマップ、リスク要件、コスト目標を支えるために、決済パートナー社や取引先銀行との商業面および業務面での交渉を主導する。
  • 財務オペレーションの専門知識が求められる、パートナー社、業界、規制当局、公の場などにおいて、Square株式会社を代表する。
  • プロダクト、エンジニアリング、リスク、コンプライアンス、法務、ポリシー、財務、マーケティング、オペレーション各チームと連携し、新たな機能を提供するとともに、日本市場固有の課題を解決する。
  • 信用照会のパフォーマンス、決済の信頼性、勘定照合、決済コスト、チャージバックの結果、取引先のパフォーマンス、運用管理体制を改善する機会を特定する。
  • 日本における規制、ネットワーク、パートナー社、業界の変化をモニタリングし、社内の各チームが足並みを揃えて対応できるよう主導する。
  • 意思決定と透明性を向上させ、責任の所在を明確にするためのガバナンス、報告体制、業務サイクル、エスカレーション経路を確立する。

応募要件

  • フィンテック、決済、銀行、カードネットワーク、加盟店契約、カード発行、決済業務、または関連する金融サービス分野での15年以上の実務経験
  • カードネットワーク、加盟店管理会社、カード発行会社、決済処理会社、銀行、規制当局、政府機関、業界団体など、日本の決済エコシステムに関する深い専門知識
  • パートナー社、金融機関、規制当局、業界団体、市場のステークホルダーの上層部との関係を構築し、働きかけてきた確かな実績
  • 複雑な契約交渉に加え、コストやリスク、コンプライアンス、顧客体験、製品がもたらす成果、成長のバランスを調整した経験を含む、ビジネス上の優れた判断力
  • パートナー社の上層部、規制当局、政府関係者、業界団体への対応や一般向けの場など、社外で会社を代表した経験
  • 不確実な状況でも周囲をリードし、複雑な課題を計画に具体化し、ビジネス、製品、オペレーション、規制、技術に関するさまざまな課題において、測定可能な成果を上げた実績
  • プロダクト、エンジニアリング、財務、法務、コンプライアンス、リスク、ポリシー、マーケティング、オペレーション各チームと連携し、複雑な部門横断的イニシアチブを主導した経験
  • 英語でのエグゼクティブレベルのコミュニケーション能力とプレゼンテーションスキル。上層のステークホルダーに対して明確かつ説得力のある提言を行う能力
  • ネイティブレベルまたはビジネスレベルの日本語能力。日本を拠点とするパートナー社や規制当局と交渉し、働きかけ、信頼関係を構築する能力を含む

望ましい経験・知識

  • 経済産業省、金融庁、または関連する決済・金融サービス分野の当局など、日本の主要な規制当局または政府機関と直接連携した経験
  • 決済ファシリテーター、加盟店契約、カード発行、決済、クリアリング、勘定照合、カードネットワークの運用モデルに関する知識
  • 米国に本社を置くフィンテック、テクノロジー、決済、または金融サービス企業での勤務経験
  • メディア対応トレーニングの受講経験、または外部スポークスパーソン、業界代表者、市場の上級責任者としての実務経験

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.

Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering. Check out our other benefits at Block.

Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ) builds technology to increase access to the global economy. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. descriptions.job-1b2jdr7:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Ripple is building the Internet of Value: infrastructure that moves money as fast as information moves today. Every payment that flows across our network passes through real-time financial crimes controls: sanctions screening, wallet risk analysis, transaction monitoring, and travel rule compliance. The Financial Crimes Engineering team builds and operates that layer.

This is the engineering that determines whether payments clear or hold, whether Ripple meets its regulatory obligations across jurisdictions, and whether the network can scale without compromising on compliance. The problem space is genuinely hard: high-throughput distributed systems, real-time decisioning, multi-source coordination across external compliance data providers, regulator-grade audit trails, and resilience.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will set the multi-year technical direction for the compliance control plane and drive its adoption beyond your own team. You will own the architecture of the vendor-agnostic, resilient, provable system that lets Ripple move value without moving financial crime, and you will shape how compliance engineering works across the company. This is a role for someone who defines which problems the organization solves, not only how they get solved: you will set the technical strategy other teams build against, establish the patterns that become organizational standards, and serve as the senior-most engineering voice on how regulatory obligations become durable infrastructure.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own the multi-year architectural vision for the compliance control plane: real-time screening orchestration, the resilience and observability layer, vendor-agnostic integration, and the decision and data plane, sequenced against where Ripple's products and regulatory surface will be in three years, not where they are today
  • Drive the hardest, highest-ambiguity technical problems end to end: multi-vendor failover, sub-second decisioning under load, regulator-grade auditability, and resilience across partial dependency failures
  • Set technical direction that extends beyond FinCrimes: define the integration contracts, resilience patterns, and compliance primitives that partner engineering teams adopt, and drive alignment across organizational boundaries where no single team owns the outcome
  • Translate evolving regulatory obligations and organizational goals into durable engineering primitives and a sequenced technical roadmap, and influence what the organization invests in to get there
  • Anticipate platform risks and scaling constraints years before they become incidents, and lead the initiatives that address them
  • Partner directly with executive leadership across Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Product to shape how regulatory requirements become engineering reality, and represent the platform's technical position to auditors, regulators, and external partners
  • Set standards for production ownership across the team and beyond: observability, alerting, incident response, and the reliability bar that other teams calibrate against
  • Multiply the technical capability of the organization: mentor staff and senior engineers, elevate design quality through architecture review, and raise the ceiling of what the team can take on

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 12+ years building production backend systems, with deep expertise in Java (or comparable JVM languages, Go, Rust)
  • A track record of owning architecture for complex distributed systems at scale across multiple teams or organizations, defining the designs that others build against and that outlast your involvement
  • Demonstrated ability to set technical direction at the organizational level and drive adoption of standards and patterns across team boundaries without formal authority
  • Strong resilience and distributed-systems design instincts: failover, graceful degradation, idempotency, high-throughput real-time decisioning, and designing systems that survive the failure of dependencies you do not control
  • Excellent API design judgment (REST/gRPC) and a history of establishing patterns that become organizational defaults
  • Proven skill navigating ambiguity in a regulated environment, turning regulator findings, audit obligations, and partner asks into shippable, durable engineering plans, and defending those decisions to auditors and examiners
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes, observability tooling (Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar), and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
  • A track record of developing senior and staff engineers and measurably lifting the technical bar of an organization
  • Experience in fintech, payments, identity, or compliance technology is a strong plus, though exceptional systems architects from adjacent high-stakes domains are welcome

WHY THIS ROLE

  • Consequence: your architecture decides whether real payments clear, in real time, for real customers.
  • Ownership beyond the platform: you are not owning a service or even a system, you are shaping the compliance control plane that every Ripple product depends on and the standards that partner teams build to.

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, investigate criminal cases, and track transnational threats. About Alchemy

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. Self-serve is how Alchemy grows. The dashboard and the developer experience around it are the primary revenue engine for our flagship products: developers discover us, sign up, get to their first call, scale their usage, and upgrade largely without ever talking to a person. That funnel is one of the most direct levers on company-level revenue we have, and this role owns it.

It's also changing fast. A growing share of developers now reach Alchemy through an AI coding agent rather than a browser tab, and we expect agent-mediated usage to become the dominant way our platform is consumed. Building for that shift, our MCP server, agent skills, and AI-native onboarding, sits squarely in this role.

You'll run the dashboard as a product, own the self-serve growth engine, and set the experimentation and measurement standard for growth across the company, partnering with Node APIs, Data APIs, Wallets, Transaction Engine, Growth Marketing, and Billing, and spending meaningful time with customers.

What you'll own

  • The dashboard. Own signup, app creation, first key, first call, usage and CU visibility, upgrade paths, team management, and the observability developers need to debug their own traffic.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Responsible for the full-process design, development, and optimization of the data center liquid cooling control system, including cooling circuit control logic, temperature/flow rate closed-loop control, energy-saving adjustment, adapting to high-density data center rack cooling requirements, and ensuring the stable and efficient operation of the liquid cooling system.
  • Lead the environmental and facility monitoring system (EFMS) design and implementation for the data center, covering monitoring of power distribution, air conditioning, liquid cooling, fire protection, security, and other infrastructure. Tasks include planning monitoring points, data collection, alarm logic design, enabling real-time monitoring and remote control of the data center's environment and device status.
  • Conduct control circuit design, including controllers, relay control cabinets, signal conditioning circuits, and more. Tasks include drawing electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, ensuring safety, reliability, and compatibility with automation needs during installation and maintenance.

  • Assist overall data center construction progress by sharing technical requirements for automation system installation, supervising on-site implementation, coordinating challenges with contractors or equipment suppliers, and ensuring quality and timelines.
  • Develop operational manuals for the automated system, perform regular inspections, troubleshoot issues, optimize control logic/programming, and implement system updates to maintain a 24/7 reliable operation. Maintain technical documentation.

How you will stand out:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in electrical automation, automation, measurement and control technology, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in automation system design, development, and debugging. Priority given to candidates with experience in large-scale data center liquid cooling systems or infrastructure monitoring projects.
  • Proficient in liquid cooling system design and development for data centers, with a solid understanding of cooling principles and the ability to independently design control logic, develop programs, and conduct system debugging.
  • Expert knowledge of facility monitoring systems architecture, capable of independent planning, data collection, alarm design, and system integration.
  • Strong ability to design control circuits, including drawing electrical schematics and wiring diagrams, and proficient in CAD, EPLAN, or similar software.
  • Expertise in component selection, including controllers, drives, and sensors, ensuring high compatibility and performance aligned with project needs.
  • Experienced in control program development, including programming for upper-level control systems and UI development, capable of independent debugging and optimization.
  • Advanced knowledge of programming languages (C, C++, Python, C#, etc.) for developing upper-level software, data visualization, and management interfaces.
  • Familiarity with communication protocols (Modbus, TCP/IP, CAN) for debugging and troubleshooting issues related to compatibility and efficiency.
  • Adept at on-site equipment debugging, including system installation, fault resolution, and functional optimization.
  • Familiarity with American NEC and UL standards is highly desirable.
  • Experience in Linux-based development is a plus.
  • Background with data center liquid cooling technologies (e.g., cold plate or immersion cooling), particularly in energy-efficient solutions, is advantageous.
  • Strong project management, communication, and coordination skills to facilitate external and internal collaborations are preferred.

What you will experience working with us:

About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket operates a CFTC-regulated designated contract market (DCM) and derivatives clearing organization (DCO). As we scale, the legal and regulatory infrastructure supporting our FCM relationships has to keep pace with the business. This role exists to own that work directly — not manage it from a distance.

You'll sit inside a small, senior legal team and work closely with Compliance, Surveillance, and product. The mandate is clear: keep the FCM function legally sound, anticipate regulatory risk before it becomes a problem, and engage with the CFTC and NFA from a position of deep technical fluency. We need someone who knows FCM regulation cold, can move quickly, and will be consulted early and often by the business — not looped in at the end to sign off.

What You'll Do

  • Advise product and business teams on CFTC implications before new features ship, not after

  • Draft and negotiate customer-facing FCM agreements, disclosures, and related documentation to ensure they are accurate, compliant, and ready to send

  • Prepare responses to CFTC and NFA regulatory inquiries and examinations, coordinating across Legal and Compliance to produce tight, well-supported submissions

  • Draft comment letters, no-action requests, and interpretive submissions on matters affecting the FCM, DCM, and DCO

  • Track CFTC enforcement actions, rulemaking, and NFA notices to surface emerging risks and translate them into actionable guidance for internal teams

  • Advise on FCM policies and procedures covering segregation, net capital, margin, and customer protection requirements

  • Support litigation strategy on matters touching FCM operations and exchange regulation

What We're Looking For

  • J.D. and active U.S. bar membership

  • 3–7 years of FCM-focused legal or compliance experience, either in private practice, at a regulator, or in-house at a derivatives firm

  • Deep working knowledge of the Commodity Exchange Act, CFTC regulations, and NFA rules, particularly as they apply to FCMs — including segregation, net capital, and margin requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to write clearly and persuasively — comment letters, no-action requests, and customer agreements that are filed or sent with minimal revision

  • A track record of being brought into business and product decisions early, not used as a last-minute legal check

  • Strong judgment about when to escalate, when to move, and how to give practical guidance under regulatory uncertainty

  • Direct experience with CFTC examination or enforcement processes

  • (Plus) Familiarity with prediction markets or event contracts

  • (Plus) Interest in emerging financial technologies and market structure

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $250,000 to $340,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and Director to lead the compliance function for our registered Futures Commission Merchant (FCM). Aptos is a people-first blockchain on a mission to help billions of people achieve universal and fair access to decentralized assets in a safe and scalable way.

Founded by some of the original creators and maintainers that researched, designed, and built the Diem blockchain to serve this purpose, we have dedicated several years toward this mission. We believe the open-source Diem technology we have developed is an important foundation of a safe and scalable web3 world where everyone has more equitable opportunities to grow and access financial assets with lower fees and fewer intermediaries.  

Aptos (Ohlone for "The People") encompasses our mission and ethos for why we build.

About this role 

Aptos is a high-performance Layer 1 designed for financial services: sub-second settlement at sub-cent cost, production reliability institutions build on, and native stablecoins including assets exclusive to the network. We are consolidating our commercial efforts into one financial services company — payments, tokenization, and trading — and payments is the first chartered business: a ring-fenced unit with its own P&L, an exclusive global settlement partnership already signed, first-party products already shipped (keyless onboarding, multisig treasury, confidential payments), and clear evidence gates at 90 days, 6 months, and 24 months.

This role is the founding technical leader of that unit. You are hire number one of the engineering team, and the build you lead defines the business.

What you'll own

  • The Aptos Payment API. Spec, ship, and run the single API businesses integrate against — wrapping partner infrastructure today, with an orchestration engine routing across a licensed partner network as the business earns it. You write the spec bottoms-up from partner and client requirements.
  • Partner-facing engineering. You are the technical face of the unit: requirements intake, integration leadership, and technical diligence with banks, EMIs, PSPs, stablecoin issuers, and e-wallet platforms. You can run those calls alone and write the requirements doc after.
  • The trust infrastructure. Revenue attribution and reconciliation (the system that proves which volume is ours), a single-window KYC/KYB integration, a testnet sandbox that lets any prospect try the stack before compliance onboarding, and a native-asset-only settlement policy — no bridges.
  • Integration with the trading stack. Our trading team builds the RFQ liquidity and tokenized-FX systems; you own the payments side of that seam — routing corridor FX through their venue, defining the API contract between the two systems, and making the handoff invisible to clients.
  • The team and the calls. Hire and lead the first two engineers; grow the team only as revenue triggers fire. Make the build-vs-buy decisions (orchestration components, KYC tooling) with written memos at each gate.

Your first 90 days

  • Publish the Payment API v1 spec and ship the testnet sandbox.
  • Stand up revenue attribution v1 and harden USDT/USDC settlement rails to production grade.
  • Ship the first client integration hands-on, end to end.
  • Draft the orchestration build-vs-buy memo that frames the unit's biggest technical decision.

These are not aspirations — they are the unit's first gate, and the role's report card is the engineering column of the business's scorecard.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years building payment infrastructure at production scale — PSP or orchestrator-class systems: cross-border rails, on/off-ramps, virtual accounts, reconciliation.
  • Hands-on chain-native settlement experience: stablecoin rails, ramp integrations, wallet infrastructure. Move or Rust a plus; strong engineering judgment on any stack a must.
  • Front-facing gravitas: banks, issuers, and regulated partners treat you as a peer. You've led external technical relationships, not just internal roadmaps.
  • A product engineer's instincts: you build bottoms-up from what clients and partners actually need, and you treat existing internal products as assets to resell — not constraints to build around.
  • Player-coach by default: you ship code, then hire people better than you at parts of it.

Nice to have

  • APAC corridor experience — e-wallet ecosystems, QR rails, regional licensing landscapes.
  • Enough FX and market-structure fluency to be a strong counterpart to the trading team on the RFQ integration.
  • Working familiarity with payments regulation (money transmission, MiCA, Singapore PS Act) — enough to design with counsel, not practice law.
  • A prior 0→1: founding engineer, first technical hire, or owner of a product line from blank page to revenue.

Why this role is unusual

  • Distribution is solved before you start. An exclusive settlement partnership routes committed volume to the network — you build against real flow, not hoped-for flow.
  • The business is chartered. Written gates, a stop condition, and growth triggers tied to revenue — you'll always know exactly where the business stands and what your work must prove next.
  • The scope compounds. What starts as one API becomes an orchestration network and a tokenized-currency framework, integrated with a trading venue's liquidity — the technical agenda grows with every gate the business clears.
  • You define the org. Every engineering hire after you is your call, made against revenue evidence.

About the Position

We are looking for Quantitative Researchers to help us build models, strategies, and systems that price and trade financial instruments. You’ll work side by side with experienced researchers who are committed to teaching, guiding, and supporting our newest hires, learning how we think about experiment design, dataset generation, time series analysis, feature engineering, and model building for financial datasets.

At Jane Street, our researchers, engineers, and traders sit a few feet away from each other and work together to train models, architect systems, and run trading strategies. We work with petabytes of data, a computing cluster with hundreds of thousands of cores, and a growing GPU cluster containing tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Depending on the day, we might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging distributed training performance, or studying how our model likes to trade in production.

We don’t believe in “one-size-fits-all” modelling solutions; we are open to and excited about applying all different types of statistical and ML techniques, from linear models to deep learning, depending on what best fits a given problem. The most successful researchers will be driven by a curiosity for how their contributions fit into the larger picture of our trading operations, and how to adapt their findings into actionable strategies.

About You

If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in. You should be:

  • Able to apply logical and mathematical thinking to all kinds of problems
  • Intellectually curious; eager to ask questions, admit mistakes, and learn new things

  • An open-minded thinker and precise communicator who enjoys collaborating with colleagues from a wide range of backgrounds and areas of expertise

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Job Responsibilities
 
End-to-End Fund Risk Strategy System Building
  • Responsible for fund security across all business lines (e.g., wealth management, trading, RWA, and other core products). Build real-time, layered risk control decision strategies based on device fingerprints, behavioral time-series, transaction chains, relationship graphs, and network features.
Risk Data Analysis, Loss Quantification & Adversarial Review
  • Leverage massive transaction data in Hive using SQL and Python to conduct risk case mining and black market attack chain reconstruction. Continuously monitor core metrics: actual loss rate, interception rate, false positive rate; identify strategy gaps and produce thematic analysis reports.
Strategy Design, Gray Release Experimentation & Iterative Deployment
  • Design rule-based strategies; manage gray-release traffic allocation, A/B experiment design, and effectiveness evaluation. Drive strategy integration into the real-time decision engine for production launch. Continuously counter black market actors, forming a closed loop of risk identification → intervention → post-mortem → iteration.
Major Loss Incident Emergency Response
  • Participate in emergency triage for major online fund security incidents: stop the bleeding, trace the risk source, and implement urgent blocks. Accumulate black market intelligence and gang characteristics to build risk feature libraries and intelligence databases.
Cross-Team Collaboration & Risk Control Capability Building
  • Coordinate with algorithm, product, engineering, compliance, and anti-fraud operations teams. Integrate machine learning models, device fingerprinting, and behavioral sequence capabilities to optimize the decision system. Abstract common risk control capabilities and drive the construction of feature platforms and risk control middle platforms.
Risk Metrics System Construction
  • Build scenario-based risk monitoring dashboards, establish anomaly fluctuation early-warning mechanisms, and drive long-term risk governance initiatives.
──────

Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree or above; Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or Data Science preferred; Master's degree preferred.
  • 3–6 years of hands-on experience in payment / internet fund security / transaction anti-fraud risk control strategy. Experience at Alipay, WeChat Pay, leading consumer finance companies, or bank online payment risk control is preferred.
Skills & Capabilities
  • Proficient in complex SQL (Hive/MaxCompute); skilled in Python for data mining and feature analysis; able to independently complete risk quantification calculations and experiment evaluation.
  • Deep understanding of payment risk scenarios: account takeover (ATO), telecom fraud, money mule/fund running, abnormal batch transactions. Familiar with real-time risk control pipelines, strategy deployment processes, and metrics evaluation frameworks.
  • Possesses an adversarial mindset; able to proactively detect emerging black market tactics from massive data. Excels at finding the optimal balance among financial loss, false interceptions, and business conversion.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

About the team

As a Network Security Engineer on Bitdeer AI Cloud's Infrastructure Security team, you will design, govern, and continuously validate the network security architecture across multiple AIDCs (AI Data Centers). The core mission is to transform today's manual, ad-hoc network access auditing into an engineered, automated, and measurable continuous-governance system — fundamentally containing the blast radius of any single point of compromise. This role sits within Infrastructure Security and reports to the Head of Security; detections it produces are handed off to SecOps for response.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Network security architecture & segmentation — Own the multi-AIDC network trust model and segmentation (north-south perimeter, east-west interconnect, micro-segmentation, Zero Trust), continuously reducing the attack surface from a malicious-tenant / supply-chain-attacker perspective.
  • Access policy lifecycle governance — Govern the design, review, and revocation of firewall rules, security groups, and ZTNA/Zscaler policies; drive Policy-as-Code, least-privilege, and TTL-based policy re-certification.
  • Continuous validation & audit automation — Build network policy drift detection and compliance-validation automation, replacing ad-hoc manual checks with continuous dashboards.
  • Endpoint & remote access security — Design fine-grained employee-endpoint → AIDC access control (identity + device posture); route privileged access through PAM/bastion + MFA.
  • Network monitoring & lateral-movement detection — Establish east-west traffic baselines and lateral-movement detection; hand off anomalies to SecOps for response.
  • AIDC fabric & management-plane security — Partner with Infrastructure/Hardware Security to harden high-speed fabric (InfiniBand/RoCE/UFM), management network (BMC/IPMI), and storage network isolation.
  • Edge & DDoS protection — Own perimeter protection and DDoS mitigation (e.g., Cloudflare-class), making explicit trade-offs between security and latency / performance budgets.
  • Compliance support — Provide network-layer control mapping and audit evidence for SOC2 / ISO 27001 / NIST.


How you will stand out:

  • 5+ years in network security engineering, with hands-on cloud / data center network security experience.
  • Strong command of network segmentation, Zero Trust, firewall & security-group policy, ZTNA (e.g., Zscaler), and SASE.
  • Familiar with public / private cloud network security (VPC/NSG, security groups, IaC).
  • Policy-as-Code and automation skills (Terraform / Ansible; Python or Go scripting).
  • Experience with network monitoring / NDR, flow analysis, and lateral-movement detection.
  • Adversarial mindset — able to assess architectural weaknesses from an attacker's view and deliver risk-graded (CRITICAL–LOW) mitigation and detection strategies.
  • AI data center / GPU cluster networking experience; familiarity with InfiniBand/RoCE/UFM.
  • eBPF-based observability (Tetragon / Cilium).
  • Financial-grade / high-compliance industry security background.
  • CISSP / CCNP Security or equivalent certification.
  • Working proficiency in both Chinese and English.

What you will experience working with us:

  • A culture that values authenticity and diversity of thoughts and backgrounds;
  • An inclusive and respectable environment with open workspaces and exciting start-up spirit;
  • Fast-growing company with the chance to network with industrial pioneers and enthusiasts;
  • Ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset industry;
  • Involvement in new projects, developing processes/systems;
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, fast growth, and learning opportunities;
  • Attractive welfare benefits and developmental opportunities such as training and mentoring.

--------------------------------------------------------------------

Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, colour, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.

descriptions.job-1of30wz:
Blockchain is connecting the world to the future of finance. As the most trusted and fastest-growing global crypto company, it helps millions of people worldwide safely access cryptocurrency. Since its inception in 2011, Blockchain has earned the trust of over 90 million wallet holders and more than 40 million verified users, facilitating over $1 trillion in crypto transactions.

We are looking for exceptional, crypto-native operators to join our team as Business Leads.

This is not a traditional strategy role. You will take ownership of a meaningful product, market, or customer segment and be accountable for turning opportunities into measurable business results. You will identify where Blockchain.com can win, develop the commercial strategy, work with Product and Engineering to build the right experience, and drive execution across the business.

You will operate at the intersection of crypto markets, product, growth, and commercial strategy. The role requires strong analytical ability, excellent judgment, deep knowledge of the crypto ecosystem, and the confidence to make decisions in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment.

You should be genuinely immersed in crypto: following markets, understanding how users behave, testing products, tracking emerging platforms and protocols, and developing your own views on where the industry is heading.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the strategy and commercial performance of a strategic product, market, or customer segment within our Consumer business.
  • Identify high-potential opportunities through market analysis, customer insight, competitive research, and a deep understanding of the crypto ecosystem.
  • Develop and test clear hypotheses for driving users, activity, volume, revenue, balances, retention, margin, and profitability.
  • Build compelling business cases covering market potential, customer demand, product requirements, economics, execution, and risk.
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to define priorities and launch customer-facing products and features.
  • Partner with Trading, Treasury, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Marketing, and Regional teams to take initiatives from idea to execution.
  • Shape pricing, positioning, distribution, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Establish a rigorous operating cadence around performance, experimentation, launches, and business results.
  • Communicate recommendations clearly, challenge assumptions, and align senior stakeholders around priorities and trade-offs.
  • Move quickly, learn from results, and continuously refine the strategy.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • A strong track record in crypto, fintech, investing, product, growth, strategy, consulting, or another highly analytical and commercially focused environment.
  • Deep knowledge of crypto markets, products, platforms, and customer behaviour. We are looking for genuine participation and curiosity—not simply an interest in the industry.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving ability, with the intellectual curiosity to go deep into unfamiliar problems.
  • Commercial judgment and comfort working with business models, pricing, funnels, unit economics, profitability, and market sizing.
  • The ability to develop clear, original views and support them with data, customer insight, and market knowledge.
  • Strong product instinct and the ability to work effectively with Product and Engineering teams.
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to influence, challenge, and align stakeholders across different functions and levels.
  • Clear, concise communication and the confidence to operate around senior leaders.
  • A hands-on mentality. You are as comfortable building the analysis and driving execution as you are presenting the strategy.
  • High agency, sound judgment, and a strong bias toward action.
  • The ambition to build something meaningful in one of the fastest-moving industries in the world.

You do not need to have followed a conventional career path. We care about the quality of your thinking, your understanding of crypto, the decisions you have made, and the results you have delivered.

COMPENSATION & PERKS

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus meaningful equity in an industry-leading company.
  • Complimentary lunch in the office and reimbursement for commuting costs.
  • Based in our SoHo office, with four days per week in person.
  • Work from Anywhere policy, allowing you to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 20 days per year.
  • Budget for learning and professional development.
  • Unlimited vacation policy—work hard and take the time you need to recharge.
  • Apple equipment.
  • A collaborative, fast-moving culture with the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
  • The opportunity to accelerate your career at a rapidly growing global technology company shaping the future of finance.

Blockchain is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

As a Senior Staff Security Engineer, you will be one of Ripple's most senior technical security practitioners, operating at the intersection of application security, cloud infrastructure security, and secure software delivery. This role exists to raise the technical bar and extend Ripple's security posture as the engineering organization scales across new products, new architectures, and an increasingly sophisticated threat landscape.

You will serve as the dedicated security engineering partner for Ripple Treasury. You will lead the technical direction for product and infrastructure security, partnering with Ripple Treasury Product and Engineering teams to drive secure design, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and cloud security architecture.

WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

  • Serve as the dedicated Security Engineering partner for Ripple Treasury BU, owning the security posture of the Treasury solution and infrastructure environment from assessment through remediation and ongoing maturity improvement.
  • Lead threat modeling and security architecture reviews across Treasury offerings.
  • Own the secure software development lifecycle for your product surface area, defining security guardrails, CI/CD integrations, and developer guidance that make secure by default a practical reality.
  • Drive the cloud security architecture for Treasury across Azure and AWS, including IAM, network segmentation, encryption, zero trust controls, Kubernetes traffic policies, and DDoS and WAF strategy, ensuring full alignment with Ripple's infrastructure standards as Treasury integrates.
  • Partner with GRC to ensure Treasury meets its compliance obligations across SOC 2, ISO 27001, and applicable financial regulatory frameworks as the BU integrates into Ripple's governance program.
  • Own vulnerability discovery via security assessments, penetration testing and bug bounty, driving findings through triage, prioritization, remediation, and validation with a bias toward automation and developer self-service.
  • Build and scale a Security Champions model within Treasury Engineering, embedding security advocates who extend the Security Engineering team's reach at scale.
  • Influence engineering architecture decisions at the senior level, participating in design reviews and architectural assessments with the standing to raise security concerns that get acted on.
  • Mentor and develop Security Engineers, raising the technical bar through threat model walkthroughs, design discussions, and structured knowledge sharing.
  • Stay ahead of the threat landscape for FinTech, crypto, and enterprise treasury systems, translating emerging attack techniques into concrete defensive improvements across platforms and systems.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 10+ years of Security Engineering experience, including hands-on work in Product Security and Infrastructure Security.
  • Expert-level product security skills including threat modeling using STRIDE or equivalent, security architecture review, OWASP Top 10 and beyond, API security, authentication and authorization design, and secure SDLC development.
  • Deep expertise in securing cloud environments across Azure, AWS, and/or GCP, covering IAM architecture, network security, secrets management, container and Kubernetes security, and infrastructure as code security.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating DevSecOps tooling, including static analysis, dynamic analysis, software composition analysis, secrets scanning, container scanning, and CI/CD pipeline security integration.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, or equivalent, with the ability to build security tooling, automate controls, and integrate security into engineering workflows without relying on third-party tools for everything.
  • Experience with cryptographic principles and key management, including HSMs, MPC, PKI, and key rotation, with an understanding of the consequences of key management failure in financial infrastructure.
  • Background in FinTech, crypto, blockchain, or high-stakes financial environments is a strong plus, particularly where security failures have direct customer or systemic financial impact.
  • A practitioner's approach. Most effective when close to the work, writing threat models, reviewing architecture documents, reading code, and building tooling.

Other common names for this role: Security Architecture, Security Engineering Lead

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

 

Payments Risk Analyst II

As a Payments Risk Analyst II on the Risk & Fraud team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll own the identification and mitigation of fraud risk across Coinbase's fiat payment rails, protecting the company's bottom line and millions of customers without degrading the user experience. You'll join a team that is modernizing its risk controls and building next-generation fraud prevention systems, giving you the opportunity to shape how we protect customers at scale across one of crypto's highest-volume retail platforms.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end risk controls for ACH payments, scaling fraud prevention processes to keep pace with business expansion.
  • Drive detection and mitigation of fraudulent deposit activity by implementing targeting logic against bad actors and high-risk behavior.
  • Lead quantitative analysis of fraud performance, measuring rule precision and recall, assessing the financial impact of decisions, and surfacing tradeoffs to leadership with clear, data-backed recommendations.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Growth, Data Science, Risk ML, and Engineering to develop and iterate on risk management strategies, including the transition from heuristic rules to model-driven and synchronous friction controls.
  • Execute investigations into anomalous customer and transaction behavior, proactively identifying monitoring gaps and closing them before they become losses.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in risk, fraud, or payments operations, with at least 2 years focused on payments fraud prevention in a fintech, e-commerce, or financial services environment.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience querying and analyzing large datasets using SQL, with the ability to independently scope and execute analytics projects end-to-end.
  • Demonstrated experience using identity-provider data and fraud-detection tooling to implement and tune risk controls.
  • Proven ability to measure the financial impact of fraud decisions and communicate findings to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of ACH payment processing and applicable NACHA rules.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

OKX runs one of the largest crypto exchange businesses in the world.
Our institutional banking relationships are central to the next phase of growth.
We are hiring a senior banker in Singapore to own the global bank relationship book under a single point of accountability, reporting to the Global Head of Strategic Partnerships.
This person is the institutional face of OKX to global banks, and the institutional face of global banks inside OKX.

What You’ll Be Doing 

  • Own the global bank relationship book as a portfolio.
    • Execute relationship strategy account by account across G-SIBs, and regional banks for the full operating and custody bank stack across all OKX regions.
    • Sequence partnership asks, manage escalations, source new partners, and own the executive ladder at each institution.
  • Serve as HQ's senior banking voice.
    • When the founder, Singapore C-Suite, or Global Head of Strategic Partnerships and his Financial Institutions Business Development Team needs a read on a counterparty — credit posture, risk appetite, partnership readiness, blockers, operationalization status and timeline — you are the call.
    • Host visiting bank executives, and you draft the narrative when OKX briefs local executives, the board, risk, payment product, or internal audit on the banking book.
  • Build the cultural bridge between bank and exchange.
    • The hardest part of being a G-SIB's chosen crypto counterparty is building and balancing the trust and business relationships between your internal and external stakeholders.
    • Translate structural and cultural differences in risk appetite, escalation culture, compliance, control, product, and operational reliance — Actively unblock issues before they become incidents.
  • Drive strategic banking workstreams.
    • Coordinate strategic banking and commercial partnerships with banks, working alongside the product and regional teams responsible for each initiative.

What We Look For In You 

  • 15–20 years inside a tier-1 global bank, with deep experience across two or more of the following:
    • Transaction and Commercial Banking / Cash Management / Correspondent Banking — The operating-account world: USD clearing, FX, wires, intraday liquidity, global T+0 rebalancing.
    • Coverage / Financial Institutions Group / Senior Relationship Management — Sector strategy, account planning, executive escalation. The senior-banker register.
    • Prime Brokerage / Securities Services / Triparty Custody — Financing, securities lending, security interest, triparty mechanics.
    • Digital Assets / Institutional Crypto Banking — A tier-1 bank's institutional digital-asset desk or equivalent. Already speaks both languages.
  • Operational and strategic understanding of:
    • How to establish long-term trust with G-SIBs as a crypto exchange counterparty;
    • Bank KYC and onboarding committee decision-making;
    • Counterparty credit treatment of a crypto exchange;
    • Triparty custody mechanics and security-interest structures;
    • Settlement, reconciliation, and intraday flow differences between bank and crypto ops;
    • Media hit handling and reputational risk;
    • Sanctions screening and AML interface between bank and exchange.
  • Meaningful experience in building credibility and fluency across Crypto and TradFi spaces.
  • Executive presence and communication range — You can cover UK / US East Coast / Singapore time zones. Regular international travel may be required.

Perks & Benefits

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Robinhood Legal team’s mission is to provide strategic, forward-looking, and comprehensive legal guidance across the entire company, enabling the safe and compliant expansion of our innovative financial offerings. We bridge the gap between complex financial regulations and cutting-edge product engineering to protect our customers, support our business growth, and maintain corporate integrity.

We are looking for an experienced and innovative credit attorney to join our product and regulatory counsel team as an Assistant General Counsel, reporting to the Director and Associate General Counsel, Derivatives, Banking, and IP at Robinhood. 

As an Assistant General Counsel, Credit Cards, you will serve as the primary legal architect and product counsel for our credit ecosystem, guiding multi-functional teams from ideation through launch. You will manage regulatory compliance, craft robust consumer agreements, and directly shape the future of our retail credit card and consumer banking initiatives! In this role, you’ll partner directly with our product, engineering, and compliance teams on consumer credit and consumer banking-related product launches! The successful candidate will be an engaged and resourceful self-starter, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and excellent at building strong relationships. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing company and add to our mission to democratize finance for all!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, or Washington, DC office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Provide end-to-end counseling on a range of retail products, including those that touch upon payments, credit cards, and banking-related products and services, working with colleagues and cross-functional stakeholders across the company
  • Respond promptly to a wide range of complex legal requests and coordinate closely with your team and outside counsel to deliver practical, timely, and high-quality advice
  • Identify and assess business and legal risks, and find creative ways to mitigate them while achieving product goals
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations
  • Advise on, review, and draft consumer agreements in support of new products
  • Develop trusted relationships to facilitate a coordinated team approach to launching new products and features
  • Be a business partner, and think like a proactive product owner, not just a legal advisor
  • Pitch in on legal work across the team whenever needed

What you bring

  • J.D. degree from an ABA-accredited law school (or foreign equivalent)
  • Membership in at least 1 U.S. State Bar, with good standing
  • 7+ years of relevant work experience across a law firm, government agency, or a fast-paced technology, financial services, banking, lending, payments, or fintech company
  • Well-developed knowledge and experience with consumer lending products, including credit cards and applicable federal consumer financial protection laws such as the Truth in Lending Act, the Equal Opportunity Credit Act, the Fair Credit Reporting Act, and the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act
  • Deep understanding of consumer banking products, including deposit accounts and applicable federal consumer financial protection laws such as the Expedited Funds Availability Act, the Truth in Savings Act, and the Electronic Fund Transfer Act
  • Experience working with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau and its rules and regulations
  • Advanced expertise with payments industry legal issues and applicable compliance requirements and regulations, including NACHA Rules, card network rules, Bank Secrecy Act / anti-money laundering rules, and state money transmission services regulation
  • Experience supporting the rollout of retail-based customer products and services
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to communicate information effectively to non-legal audiences and drive cross-functional alignment
  • An execution-oriented mindset with the agility, drive, and creativity to deliver results

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

$217,000—$255,000 USD

$191,000—$224,000 USD

$170,000—$199,000 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for Senior Product Managers to drive institutional client growth, manage market maker and VIP programs, and deliver credit and lending products for OKX's institutional client base — including hedge funds, trading firms, asset managers, and financial institutions.
Depending on background, the role may focus on: (a) Institutional client management — VIP programs, market maker programs, and fund/asset manager operations; (b) Institutional credit products — VIP Loan, Credit Line, Post-Trade Settlement; or (c) Growth strategy and cross-team initiatives — Driving quarterly growth plans in partnership with Core Trading, Retail, and Earn teams.
This is a strategic and hands-on role where you'll collaborate closely with engineering, risk, compliance, sales/BD, and relationship management teams to deliver secure, scalable, and client-centric solutions that power OKX's institutional offerings.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Product Strategy and Delivery

  • Understand the institutional market landscape by analysing client needs, competitor offerings, and market trends. Identify differentiation opportunities in partnership with Sales/BD and Relationship Management teams.
  • Design and optimize VIP fee tier programs, market maker incentive structures, and institutional client retention strategies. Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned product lines (e.g. VIP Loan, Credit Line, Delayed Settlement, MM programs, or fund management tools).
  • Gather and prioritise product and client requirements using data-driven analysis. Manage the institutional client lifecycle: onboarding, activation, engagement, upsell, and retention — Translating client pain points into roadmap priorities with clear business impact.

  • Develop financial and non-financial metrics and KPIs to track progress and alignment to firm’s overall strategy and goals. Solicit both internal and external client feedback, understand the various challenges and opportunities and re-prioritise the roadmap iteratively to optimise results. Manage technical backlogs and prioritise new features vs technical debt to eliminate workflow friction.

Client Engagement and Growth

  • Develop strategic partnerships and maintain relationships with key institutional clients. Coordinate with RM/BD teams on client onboarding, tier management, and retention strategies.
  • Drive quarterly growth strategies in collaboration with Core Trading, Retail Growth, and Earn teams, including cross-sell initiatives, incentive program design, and institutional product bundling.
  • Build business cases for product and partnership investments with clear ROI frameworks. Quantify the revenue and AUM impact of product features to drive prioritisation decisions. Own the commercial logic of assigned institutional product lines.

What We Look For In You 

  • Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product launch throughout its lifecycle. Adept at translating product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes. Experience with institutional credit products (margin lending, secured financing, delayed settlement, or credit line structures) is preferred.
  • Proven experience engaging directly with institutional clients — Conducting business reviews, gathering requirements on-site, and translating client pain points into product roadmap priorities. Experience working with sales/BD/relationship management teams in a B2B institutional environment.
